property_summary: After any call to allowance, the totalSupply must be invariant (must not have been reset to zero).
A call to allowance does not change totalSupply.
After a call to allowance(address,address), totalSupply must remain unchanged from its value before the call.
After calling allowance(address,address), totalSupply must remain equal to sum of balances of all accounts.
After a call to allowance, totalSupply must be greater than or equal to the minimum possible value it could have been before (i.e., not reset to zero when it was previously non-zero).
After a call to `allowance`, `totalSupply` must be less than or equal to the sum of all balances.

After any sequence of operations ending with a call to allowance, the totalSupply must equal the sum of balances of all addresses computed via external balanceOf calls on the contract's own known addresses.
After any sequence of operations ending with a call to allowance, the totalSupply must be greater than or equal to the minimum of totalSupply after any single burn.
After any sequence of operations ending with a call to allowance, totalSupply must be non-decreasing (i.e., it must never decrease from one call to the next).

After any sequence of operations ending with a call to allowance, totalSupply must equal the sum of balances of all addresses that have ever held tokens, computed by iterating over all possible addresses via balanceOf.
For all addresses a and b, calling allowance(a,b) never changes totalSupply.
totalSupply remains unchanged after any call to allowance.
Calling allowance with any two addresses does not change totalSupply.
Calling allowance with any two identical addresses does not change totalSupply
Calling allowance(pool, pool) on the synth after transferring synth tokens to it does not change totalSupply.
After calling allowance(address,address) with arbitrary arguments, totalSupply remains unchanged from its initial value (zero).
After calling allowance(address,address) with arbitrary addresses, totalSupply remains unchanged from its initial value (zero).
After calling allowance(address,address) with arbitrary addresses, the sum of balanceOf(c) + totalSupply() remains constant (equal to the initial totalSupply, which is zero).
After calling allowance with arbitrary addresses, totalSupply() is strictly less than it was before the call.
After calling allowance with arbitrary addresses, totalSupply remains unchanged from its initial value (zero).
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPBalance for any key remains unchanged.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the value of mapSynth_LPBalance for any address is always less than or equal to the total supply of the synth token.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance is preserved for the key that is zero address.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the difference between mapSynth_LPBalance[caller] and mapSynth_LPDebt[caller] is always non-negative.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), for any address k, the value of mapSynth_LPBalance[k] is equal to mapSynth_LPDebt[k].
After calling allowance, the value of a particular key in the mapSynth_LPBalance mapping remains unchanged (i.e., the same before and after the call).
After calling allowance, the balance of the contract's own address in the pool remains unchanged.
After any call to allowance(address, address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all addresses never decreases.
After calling allowance on the synth, mapSynth_LPBalance for the caller's pool does not increase if the caller is not a curated pool.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the contract's total balance of LP tokens (iBEP20(pool).balanceOf(address(c))) is at least as large as the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all pools.
After calling allowance, the synths' LP balance for the pool equals the state before the call.
After allowance is called, the LP balance for any address does not decrease relative to its previous value.
The caller's mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] remains unchanged after a call to allowance(address,address).
After a call to allowance, the total LP balance sum over all addresses remains unchanged (i.e., the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance across all pools does not change).
After a call to allowance, the LP balance of the caller for the pool address passed as the second argument to allowance remains unchanged.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPBalance of the pool that called burnSynth remains unchanged.

After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the total supply of the synth contract (c.totalSupply()) remains invariant (unchanged) if allowance is called without any prior minting operation.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance[pool] over all pools equals the total supply of the synth contract (c.totalSupply()).

After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] is always less than or equal to mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] for the pool that called burnSynth.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the sum of totalSupply is equal to the sum of all mapSynth_LPBalance values where mapSynth_LPDebt is positive.
After calling allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool key should be unchanged.
After calling allowance, the balanceOf of address(this) must equal the total supply minus the sum of all LP balances.

After calling allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance for the pools that have non-zero debt should be no less than when it was left after the last operation, because the only modifier is realise which only reduces it when premium is large enough.

After calling allowance, the value of mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool address is never less than mapSynth_LPDebt for that same pool, because the reference contract only reduces LP balance when premium is >= 1e18, ensuring LP balance covers debt.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all pools with non-zero debt is greater than or equal to the sum of mapSynth_LPDebt for those same pools.
The realise function should never increase the balance of mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool when called with a premium greater than 10^18 and baseValueLP > baseValueSynth.
calling allowance with the C contract address as owner and spender should not change the mapSynth_LPBalance of any pool that has deposited LP tokens
Calling allow(owner, spender) does not change mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool that has a non-zero LP balance.

After calling allowance(address,address), the mapSynth_LPBalance of any pool that has ever deposited LP tokens is exactly the balance of LP tokens held by the C contract for that pool, computed as the difference between the C contract's current LP token balance and the amount recorded in mapSynth_LPBalance for that pool.
Calling allowance(address,address) never increases mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool from its value before the call.
After any sequence of public calls, calling allowance(someAddress, someAddress) leaves mapSynth_LPDebt for the caller's pool unchanged.
After any call to allowance, the pool's mapSynth_LPDebt is always less than or equal to its mapSynth_LPBalance.
After any call to allowance, mapSynth_LPDebt[pool] remains unchanged relative to its value before the call.

After calling allowance(address,address) on the synth contract, the mapSynth_LPDebt of any known pool should not exceed the amount of LP tokens the contract holds for that pool, as the burnSynth function should correctly decrement debt when burning.

After any sequence of public calls, calling allowance(a,b) on the synth contract does not change mapSynth_LPDebt for any address that was not involved in the sequence, and for any involved address, the debt never exceeds the LP balance held by the contract for that address.
The name() function returns a value that does not start with the token's name.
The name() function returns a string that is not an empty string.
The name() function returns a string equal to the concatenation of the underlying token's name with '-SpartanProtocolSynthetic'.
Calling name() on the contract returns a string that is at least as long as the name of the underlying token.
Calling name() returns a string that, when combined with the token's name to form a prefix, does not start with the token's name itself twice in a row.
For any address, calling symbol() always returns the same string as the reference implementation (which concatenates the token symbol with '-SPS').
Calling symbol() always returns a string that starts with the token's symbol prefix (i.e., the token's symbol concatenated with '-SPS').
Calling symbol() always returns exactly the same string as the name() of the underlying token (LayerONE) concatenated with '-SPS'.
Calling symbol() returns a string whose length is always greater than the length of '-SPS'.
Calling symbol() on the contract returns the same value as iBEP20(LayerONE).symbol() concatenated with the suffix '-SPS'.

After allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance(pool) for the pool that last called burnSynth remains unchanged (i.e., the buggy version incorrectly decreases it when burning zero).

After calling allowance, the total supply of the synthetic token equal to the sum of all balances equals the total amount minted minus the total amount burned.
